items.title: Don Wolff interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 13, 1996
items.q: But when I think of American original art form music, Duke Ellington is at the top of my list.

ctx.x: Is Basie is personal favorite of yours?

Well Ellington is number one. I think Duke Ellington, well you heard Basie in the films yesterday agree with that comment. I think Basie, and I met Count Basie a number of times personally. I think on a personal level he was the most genuine. He was the nicest. Success never went to the head of Bill Basie. He was the same, I think, when he was getting started with Bennie Moten and probably didn’t have two nickels to rub together, as in the latter part of his life when he was a very wealthy, successful man. It…
Right. Who is a better American composer than Duke Ellington?
